# laravelforge_site_deploy_key (Resource)

Manages the deploy key for a Laravel Forge site. Singleton per site: one deploy key per site, created on POST and removed on DELETE. There is no update — any change recreates it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization` (String) Organization slug.
- `server_id` (Number) ID of the server that owns the site.
- `site_id` (Number) ID of the site the deploy key belongs to.

### Read-Only

- `key` (String) The public deploy key for the site.
